name: Sika CarboDur BC
paste:
SIKA® CARBODUR® BC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® CarboDur® BC, May 2024, Version 03.05 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sika_carbodur_bc.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® CarboDur® BC where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2024, Version 03.05).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sika® CarboDur® BC rods are pultruded carbon fibre reinforced polymer (CFRP) laminates with a circular cross section, designed for strengthening concrete, timber and masonry.
    - Sika® CarboDur® BC rods are bonded into slots as near surface mounted reinforcement using Sika AnchorFix®-3001, Sika AnchorFix®-3030, Sikadur®-330 or Sikadur®-30 epoxy resin based adhesives for normal application temperatures, or Sikadur®-30 LP* epoxy resin based adhesive for elevated temperatures during application. Sikadur®-300 epoxy resin based adhesive is used for horizontal applications.
    - Sika® CarboDur® BC rods can also be used for anchoring SikaWrap® fabrics where positive attachment to concrete or masonry is required.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sika® CarboDur® BC may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Sika® CarboDur® BC rods are used to improve, increase or repair the performance and resistance of structures for:
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Increased Load Carrying Capacity.
    - Increasing the load capacity of floor slabs, beams and bridge sections
    - For the installation of heavier machinery
    - To stabilise vibrating structures
    - For changes in building use
1.5 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Damage to structural elements due to.
    - Deterioration of the original construction materials
    - Steel reinforcement corrosion
    - Accidents (Vehicle impact, earthquakes, fire)
1.6 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Improvement of serviceability and durability.
    - Reduced deflection and crack width
    - Stress reduction in the steel reinforcement
    - Improved fatigue resistance
1.7 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Change of the structural system.
    - Removal of walls and / or columns
    - Removal of floor and wall sections to create access / openings
1.8 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Resistance to possible events.
    - Increased resistance to earthquakes, impact or explosion etc.
    - Insufficient / inadequate reinforcement
    - Insufficient / inadequate structural depth
    To repair design or construction defects such as:
1.9 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Combination with other strengthening products.
    - Doweling applications
    - Anchoring of SikaWrap® fabrics
1.10 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® CarboDur® BC
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: PULTRUDED CARBON FIBRE RODS FOR STRUCTURAL STRENGTHENING AS PART OF THE SIKA® CARBODUR® SYSTEM
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Poland: Technical Approval IBDiM Nr AT/2008-03- 0336/1 „Płaskowniki. pręty, kształtki i maty kompozytowe do wzmacniania betonu o nazwie handlowej: Zestaw materiałów Sika® CarboDur® do wzmacniania konstrukcji obiektów mostowych
    - Fib, Technical Report, bulletin 14: Externally bonded FRP reinforcement for RC structures, July 2001
    - Italy: CNR-DT 200/2004 - Guide for the Design and Construction of Externally Bonded FRP Systems for Strengthening Existing Structures
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 2561: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Laminate elongation at break in tension Minimum value (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate tensile strength (p.2).
    - EN 61006: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Glass transition temperature (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Non-corroding
    - Very high strength
    - Invisible once installed, no joints required
    - Excellent durability and fatigue resistance
    - Easy transportation
    - Lightweight, very easy to install
    - Smooth edges without exposed fibres as the result of production by pultrusion
    - Can accept traffic on the strengthened surface (rods not exposed)
    - No surface preparation / levelling of uneven substrates required
    - Improved resistance to fire (compared with externally bonded reinforcement)
    - Testing and Approvals available from many countries worldwide
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Carbon fibre reinforced polymer with an epoxy matrix, black.
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fibre volume content: > 65 %
    - Laminate elongation at break in tension Minimum value: > 1.70 % (EN 2561)
    - Glass transition temperature: > 100 °C (EN 61006)
2.7 Dimensions.
    | Type | Diameter | Cross sectional area |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC6 | 6 mm | 28 mm² |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC8 | 8 mm | 50 mm² |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC10 | 10 mm | 79 mm² |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC12 | 12 mm | 113 mm² |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC16 | 16 mm | 201 mm² |
2.8 Laminate tensile strength.
    | Mean value | 3,100 N/mm² |
    | 5% Fractile value | 2,900 N/mm² |
    Test method printed: (EN 2561)
    Note printed: Values in the longitudinal direction of the fibres
2.9 Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension.
    | Mean value | 148,000 N/mm² |
    Test method printed: (EN 2561)
    Note printed: Values in the longitudinal direction of the fibres
2.10 System structure. The system build-up and configuration as described must be fully complied with and may not be changed. Resin Adhesive – Sika AnchorFix®-3001, Sika AnchorFix®-3030, Sikadur®- 330*, Sikadur®-30, Sikadur®-30 LP*. Sikadur®-30 LP* is not available in Australia lead time may apply. Structural strengthening Carbon plates – Sika® CarboDur® BC; For detailed information on the different resins, together with the application details, please refer to the latest Product Data Sheets and the “Method Statement Sika® CarboDur® Near Surface Mounted Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 07
2.11 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Supplied in 6 and 12 m long bars (BC 8, BC 10, BC 12, BC 16) custom lengths can be made to order. BC12 in stock and available locally. Please call your local Sika office for lead times.
    - Shelf life: Unlimited, provided the storage conditions are met.
2.12 Storage conditions. Store in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures of max. +50 °C. Protect from direct sunlight. Transportation: only in the original packaging, or otherwise adequately protected against any mechanical damage

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2024, Version 03.05) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Please refer to the “Method Statement Sika® CarboDur® Near Surface Mounted Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 07

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2024, Version 03.05) and the requirements below.
4.2 Consumption.
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC6 | ≤ 0.12 kg/m |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC8 | ≤ 0.18 kg/m |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC10 | ≤ 0.24 kg/m |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC12 | ≤ 0.32 kg/m |
    | Sika® CarboDur® BC16 | ≤ 0.36 kg/m |
4.3 Application method / tools - Please refer to the relevant Product Data Sheet.
    - Sikadur®-30
    - Sikadur®-30 LP*
    - Sikadur®-330
    - Sikadur® Hex-300
    - Sikadur®-33
    - Sika AnchorFix®-3001
    - Sika AnchorFix®-3030
    Please refer to the “Method Statement Sika® CarboDur® Near Surface Mounted Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 07
    *Sikadur® 30 LP not available in Australia, lead time applies.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations. Please refer to the relevant Sika epoxy adhesive Product Data Sheet:
    - Sikadur®-30
    - Sikadur®-30 LP*
    - Sikadur®-330
    - Sikadur® Hex-300
    - Sikadur®-33
    - Sika AnchorFix®-3001
    - Sika AnchorFix®-3030
    A suitably qualified Structural Engineer must be responsible for the design of the strengthening works. Additionally as this application is structural, great care must also be taken in selecting suitably experienced and trained specialist contractors.
    Sikadur®-30 LP* not available in Australia, contact Sika Australia for lead times or alternative solutions. Maximum permissible continuous service temperature is approx. +50 °C.
    Please also refer to the “Method Statement Sika® CarboDur® Near Surface Mounted Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 07 for further limitations and guidelines. Contact Sika technical service for detailed advice.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.4):
    - Sikadur®-30 LP* not available in Australia, contact Sika Australia for lead times or alternative solutions. Maximum permissible continuous service temperature is approx. +50 °C.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Laminate tensile strength: Mean value | 3,100 N/mm²; 5% Fractile value | 2,900 N/mm² (EN 2561)
    - Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension: Mean value | 148,000 N/mm² (EN 2561)
    - Laminate elongation at break in tension Minimum value: > 1.70 % (EN 2561)
    - Glass transition temperature: > 100 °C (EN 61006)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® CarboDur® BC, May 2024, Version 03.05, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sika_carbodur_bc.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
